subject: general
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/trnQvbeCkt_1Dz_RdhRkOn93vT7kw9xYz4-rzfvNwTNnatOakizuZAzuq08MUl78ozyXIn5BeZSnGGm0E9QQ1GFDAEz6CFZESjHLudHWO7Rx_mVrGRlh7r1q1hx6xJGApVMBMQeVWCLZlTi_2JlgZw] 

**Logic: first letter + 4 = second letter then, third letter is opposite of second letter.**

1) PSH

⇒** P(16) + 3 = S(19)**

⇒ **S(19) opposite value is H(8)**

2) SWD 

⇒ S(19) + 4 = W(23) 

⇒ W(23) opposite value is D(4)

3) LPK

⇒ L(12) + 4 = P(16)

⇒ P(16) opposite value is K(11)

4() FJQ

⇒ F(6) + 4 = J(10)

⇒ J(10) opposite value is Q(17)

Cleary, PSH is different from all.

Hence, the correct answer is **"PSH".**
